newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Clinton seen raising Iran at EU/US summit.
newsitem.headline: Clinton seen raising Iran at EU/US summit.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton is expected to raise the issue of relations with Iran at a summit in the Hague next week with the European Union, U.S. officials said on Thursday.
One official said the position of the two sides towards Iran was now "closer that it has been" following the EU's decision to end its so-called critical dialogue with Tehran.

Washington has long argued for the EU to isolate Iran, which it sees as a pariah state that sponsors terrorism. The EU, however, has followed a different path, seeking to bring Iran closer to the West through talks.
But the EU policy was suspended last month after a German court ruled that Tehran had been involved in the murder of Iranian Kurd leaders in Berlin.
The U.S. official said the issue of Iran was brought up at nearly every high-level meeting between the EU and Washington and that the summit on May 28 in the Hague would prove no different.
